description: This file defines the MigrationAPI class within the OrangeHRM system, specifically in the Upgrader API namespace. It provides REST API endpoints for managing database migrations, including retrieving available migration versions and executing migrations between versions.

classes.name: MigrationAPI
classes.description: A REST API controller class handling migration version retrieval and execution via GET and POST requests.

methods.name: handleGet
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve available migration versions within a specified range.

methods.name: handlePost
methods.description: Handles POST requests to execute migration scripts for a specified version or between two versions.
